channel.title: Liberia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Liberia, every source cited.

item.title: Liberia Baptist Seminary opens conference on drug addiction
item.description: The Liberia Baptist Theological Seminary conference addresses drug addiction, recovery, and youth empowerment.

item.title: US investors eye Liberia's mining and energy sectors
item.description: American companies are exploring long-term investment in Liberia's mineral resources and energy infrastructure.

item.title: Liberia's NaFAA secures US$325,000 FAO grant
item.description: The funds will support a new fish sales hub in Congo Town, Monrovia, with a cooling room and training.

item.title: Liberia Water Justice Forum launched to demand safe water access
item.description: A new advocacy group calls on the Liberian government to ensure equitable and affordable provision of safe drinking water for all citizens.

item.title: Liberia proposes $261M disability sports village
item.description: Amb. S. Lionel Johnson envisions a 10-year project to build accessible facilities and provide specialized support for athletes with disabilities.
